notes.title: NEW UPDATE 2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Who will be the best SurviBall?[/h1]

Check out our last game mode where our rollers will have to survive finishing as maps as possible in a single game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21373474/9eb41d89b1838c55e98650f11f0a23082880fe8b.jpg[/img]
Infinite turbo, switch between unlocked balls while you play, what are you waiting for to try it?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21373474/e4a2d8db449e686d173743fbcde2777f2131fa24.png[/img]
Leaderboard has been adapted to Steam in order to find out who is the best Spheria roller. 

20 maps are waiting for you to finish them all and became the [b]new SurviBall![/b]

Have fun!

notes.title: New game mode upcoming!
notes.content:
[h1]SurviBalls[/h1]

Last week we presented on Tenerife Lan Party 2016 our upcoming new game mode SurviBalls.
The players could play during the event and we celebrated a contest to find out the best local player on Spheria SurviBalls.

Congratulations to the winner G-Inator!

We received feedback and adjusted this new mode, during this month it will be made public for all you rollers

On this game mode the main purpose is to finish the 20 maps from Real World all with just one try. Our best player has reached level 13 during the days of the contest, will you reach it?

To make it fair for the rollers, on this game mode you have infinite turbo and you can switch between unlocked balls on the fly pressing twice turbo button, just to get adapted in all situations, here you can see a little screenshot of the upcoming version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21373474/aa5c92cdcfae87a10b57dab557ccfe06a207a3d4.jpg[/img]

Keep on rolling!

notes.title: Spring Update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello Rollers! 
We've been working on redesign Spheria experience focusing on making the game more competitive between users, we have a secret plan to accomplish that. This new update 2.0 is our first step with that purpose in mind. 

Latest changes:
[b]- Redesigned in-game interface[/b]
[i]Players can now have more information about the map they are playing like last best local time as well as the best online player on that map.[/i]
[img]http://daydreamsoftware.es/spheria/imgs/Screenshots-v2/ScreenshotNewUI.jpg[/img]

[b]- New Turbo Boost for every ball.[/b]
[i]Now players can activate limited velocity boost which is reloaded with every time an engine is activated.[/i]
[img]http://daydreamsoftware.es/spheria/imgs/Screenshots-v2/Turbo3-Opt.gif[/img]

[b]- Improved controls[/b]
[i]Map preview in game has been replaced by zoom buttons allowing players to zoom in and out without stop rolling.
Turbo activation has been adapted for all supported controls[/i]
[img]http://daydreamsoftware.es/spheria/imgs/Screenshots-v2/ScreenshotNewUI3.jpg[/img]

[b]- Refined user experience[/b]
[i]We have added more animations and new effects to bring the players the Spheria experience as immersive as possible.
Bug fixes and parameters recalibration.
[/i]

Keep updated! All these changes will be uploaded to the game on [b]the next few days[/b].

Try it out and break the scores with this new update! ːsteammockingː
